spans.text: ...In the end, the defensive battle didn't buy enough time, and Task Force DEFY couldn't finish installing the IEDs within the time limit.
The commander is forced to abort the mission and instructs the rescue party to withdraw before the military breaches the structure.
Yegor later enters the building...and finds Angelia.
Angelia, you've been pulling off trick after trick.
I'm fully prepared for that, but I still feel compelled to applaud your resourcefulness.
Sadly, our game of hide-and-seek has still come to an end...
I knew you'd come.
But I didn't expect you to come alone.
I know that nothing poses a threat to me in this building. I'm just here to kill you. I don't need help for that.
I still have two T-Dolls with me, Yegor. You shouldn't throw your own life away so easily. We all want to kill you very much.
Thanks to your dirty bomb, I will be court-martialed even if I return to the Military. My subordinates will finish what I started.
You know, if I die here, at least I'll still be a hero.
You're not a hero, Yegor. Never.
I am what history says I am...
History is written by the victors!
And we WILL be the victors!
...Yegor raises his pistol.
Yegor...
You don't even know...what victory really is.
You'll never know what it costs to win!
The cost of victory...is to become history!
...Bang!
...Bang, bang, bang!
...Meanwhile.
Commander...
The Military forces laying siege just destroyed the building.
According to the communication logs, Yegor killed Ange, then he was slain by Task Force DEFY.
After that, the Military forces received orders to demolish the building. No sign of survival from Task Force DEFY.
Our mission is over, Commander.
We will reach our set course in ten minutes. Then we will be on our way to rescue you.
At least let us do that and complete this one last mission...
We are surprised you are still capable of such deception under these circumstances.
We have truly underestimated you, Griffin Commander.
We must administer a larger, but not fatal, dosage.
A Nyto takes out another syringe and injects the truth serum into my veins.
The effect starts kicking in quickly, but I can still resist it. I still have a bit of willpower...though I don't know if I'm already running on fumes...
Ange did not die, at least not in this battle. We saw her kill one of us with our very own eyes.
So tell us how she survived and with whom she has had dealings.
I will tell them everything that comes to mind.
The lies, the truth. Let them guess.
I know what they're really after. I also know the consequences of giving them what they want.
Humans are fragile contraptions that break down easily.
If you wish to leave this facility with your mind and body intact, value the chance you have been given and tell the truth.
That's why I need time...as well as all sorts of fantasies to counter the truth serum.
How many more times will Miss Ange die in my story?
At the very least, she has to keep dying till I can live...
